title: pgcopy JSON envelope
description: The single response shape every pgcopy command emits with --json. Stable from day 0 (Cut 0). See docs/design.md §4.1 and src/postgres_table_copy/cli.py:build_envelope.

command.description: The command that produced this envelope, e.g. 'endpoints add', 'plan'.

job_id.description: Job identifier (j_<YYYYMMDD>_<HHMMSS>_<rand4>) for commands that operate on a job; null otherwise.

error.description: Human-readable error message; null on success.

error_category.description: Category driving the exit code: CONFIG/AUTH->1, TRANSIENT->2, DATA->3, INTERNAL->4. null on success.
